payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the improvements in accuracy of the Attention-Sum Reader model when trained on the BookTest dataset compared to the original Children's Book Test dataset.

claims.text: Training on the BookTest dataset improves the accuracy of the Attention-Sum Reader model on the original CBT test data significantly, exceeding human baseline performance.
Using the BookTest dataset reduces prediction error by almost one third compared to using the original CBT training data.
The model trained on the BookTest dataset achieved improvements in accuracy much larger than those obtained by enhancing the model architecture alone.
